autoPolicy.title: Auto Backup policies
autoPolicy.description: Save a calendar schedule for full backups. Saving starts at the next scheduled time, not immediately. Manual backups are separate.

autoPolicy.timezoneHelp: Schedules use the selected timezone's wall clock. Daylight-saving changes may skip or repeat a local time; use UTC for a schedule without daylight-saving transitions.
autoPolicy.invalidMetadata: Invalid saved schedule value; edit this policy before resuming.
autoPolicy.calendarHelp: Zero disables a tier; counts are 0–30. Monthly day is limited to 1–28 so it exists every month. Coincident runs create one full backup: monthly takes precedence over weekly, then daily.
autoPolicy.force: Authorize forced backups for this saved schedule
autoPolicy.forceRisk: If this volume is in use at a scheduled run, forced backup copies data while writes may continue. Data may be inconsistent; neither crash consistency, application consistency nor successful restore is guaranteed. Quiesce writes or use application-specific procedures when needed.
autoPolicy.forceScope: This permission is saved for this source policy and applies to every future scheduled run until you edit or remove it. Manual-backup consent is separate and never transfers.
autoPolicy.forceOff: Forced scheduled backups are not authorized; in-use runs will be skipped.
autoPolicy.forceOn: Forced backups are authorized across future runs for this saved source policy.
autoPolicy.removeConfirm: Remove the Auto Backup policy for {name}? Existing backups will not be deleted.
autoPolicy.invalid: Choose a source, a valid HH:mm and IANA timezone, counts from 0–30, and at least one positive count when enabled. In-use enabled schedules require explicit force authorization.
autoPolicy.saveFailed: Could not save the Auto Backup policy.
autoPolicy.removeFailed: Could not remove the Auto Backup policy.
autoPolicy.reader: Read-only access: Auto Backup policies cannot be changed.
